pricing.details: Free 0 €/month — room for about 50,000 requests/month (at 5k tokens each), 1 GB of data/month, 5k requests scored/month, 30 days of history. Starter regular 71 €/month — about 250,000 requests/month, 5 GB then 3 €/GB, 10k requests scored/month then 2 € per 1k, 90 days of history. Official launch promo: Starter free for 6 months for teams who sign up by 22 November 2026 (this is a promo, not the regular Starter price). Pro 225 €/month — about 1,000,000 requests/month. Enterprise custom. Unlimited seats on every plan.
